## CVE-2026-19868: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability

Source-reported by [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?search_api_fulltext=CVE-2026-19868).

CVE-2026-19868 (CVSS 7.5, scored by CISA; SonicWall and NVD have not published a score): An authentication enforcement vulnerability in SonicOS SSLVPN service may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA). CISA lists it as exploited in the wild.

Affected: SonicOS Gen7 7.3.3-7015 and older, and Gen8 8.2.2-8015 and older, according to the CVE record.

Defensive action: Apply the fix in SonicWall advisory [SNWLID-2026-0014](https://psirt.global.sonicwall.com/vuln-detail/SNWLID-2026-0014). If no update or mitigation is available, take the product out of service.

Limitations: Source-reported; SecOpsAI did not reproduce the issue.

Added to the CISA KEV catalog 6 Nov 2026; first seen by SecOpsAI 6 Nov 2026, 23:46 UTC.

Identifiers and scores checked automatically against cve.org and NVD.

## fastapi-code-generator: Import-time RCE via response status-code key -> unescaped @app.get(..., responses={...}) dict

Source-reported by [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6xmv-cjr5-w3q8).

CVE-2026-63469 (official CVSS 9.3): A multi-response OpenAPI operation with an attacker-controlled or attacker-influenced second non-primary response key can close the dictionary-key literal and inject a valid Python expression. Syntax-breaking input only causes generation to fail, but syntactically valid generated code executes with the application's or CI process's privileges when the generated module is imported and its decorator arguments are evaluated.

Defensive action: Upgrade to a fixed release: fastapi-code-generator 0.8.1.

Limitations: Source-reported; SecOpsAI did not reproduce the issue.

Published 9 Nov 2026, 19:46 UTC; first seen by SecOpsAI 9 Nov 2026, 20:51 UTC.

## fastapi-code-generator: Import-time RCE via route path -> unescaped @app.get('...') decorator

Source-reported by [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p2mm-64f6-gmpp).

CVE-2026-63471 (official CVSS 9.3): An attacker-controlled or attacker-influenced OpenAPI path can close the string and inject a valid Python expression into the decorator argument. Syntax-breaking input only causes generation to fail, but syntactically valid generated code executes with the application's or CI process's privileges when the generated module is imported and the decorator is evaluated.

Defensive action: Upgrade to a fixed release: fastapi-code-generator 0.8.1.

Limitations: Source-reported; SecOpsAI did not reproduce the issue.

Published 9 Nov 2026, 19:48 UTC; first seen by SecOpsAI 9 Nov 2026, 20:51 UTC.

## Signal K resources API path traversal can disclose the JWT signing secret and enable remote code execution

Source-reported by [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4xm8-rg9h-jhq2).

CVE-2026-123807 (official CVSS 9.8): The route passes the attacker-controlled resourceId through src/api/resources/index.ts to FileStore.getResource() in packages/resources-provider-plugin/src/filestorage.ts without adequate path containment, allowing arbitrary JSON files reachable by the server to be read. Related PUT and DELETE resource operations can write or delete files outside the storage root.

Defensive action: Upgrade to a fixed release: signalk-server 2.34.0, @signalk/resources-provider 1.5.3.

Limitations: Source-reported; SecOpsAI did not reproduce the issue.

Published 30 Oct 2026, 22:57 UTC; first seen by SecOpsAI 9 Nov 2026, 20:51 UTC.

## fastapi-code-generator: Call-time RCE via operation summary -> unescaped route-handler docstring

Source-reported by [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-h667-4jj2-cgv4).

CVE-2026-63470 (official CVSS 9.3): An attacker-controlled or attacker-influenced operation summary can close the docstring and inject a valid Python expression statement into the handler body. Syntax-breaking input only causes generation to fail, but syntactically valid generated code executes with the server process's privileges when the affected route handler is called.

Defensive action: Upgrade to a fixed release: fastapi-code-generator 0.8.1.

Limitations: Source-reported; SecOpsAI did not reproduce the issue.

Published 9 Nov 2026, 18:50 UTC; first seen by SecOpsAI 9 Nov 2026, 19:27 UTC.

Identifiers and scores checked automatically against cve.org and NVD.

SecOpsAI detection: `secopsai supply-chain advisory-check --advisory GHSA-h667-4jj2-cgv4 PATH` flags fastapi-code-generator before 0.8.1 in a project's manifests and lockfiles.
